The '''Imperial Ordnance Acquisition Corps''' were an organization within the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] that was tasked to amass scientific advances able to be used against the Empire's enemies. Under [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kresk]], they were known to have collected sixty-thousand [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]] [[R-6000 blaster rifle]]s and a sizable amount of the corrupt corporation's experimental technology during the [[Seizure of CZ-198]].<ref name="Titans" />
